item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-11-13
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 今天论坛的主要动态集中在 CKB 原生 DeFi、论坛身份、测试网支付工具和提案投票上 [S02, S06, S09, S13]。CellScript 路线图第一部分已实现，v0.33-alpha1 正等待 Guopeng 团队验收审计 [S02]。LusoCryptoLabs 同时推进 Cellula Wallet 测试网隐私支付，并开源了 Swap book 的代码 [S09, S10]。此外，FiberNuts 提案在投票关闭后确认通过，TalkDID 也继续讨论把 did:ckb 绑定到 Nervos Talk [S13, S06]。 ## 重点话题 CellScript 路线图更新：ArthurZhang 表示 Part 1 已实现，v0.33-alpha1 等待验收审计 [S02]。psawyerberlin 指出 Part 2 多项功能需要有人后续提交交易，包括托管订单结算、#72 到期和 #74 非托管订阅 [S03]。 是否集成 CSR 的讨论：ArthurZhang 回应称不计划把 CSR 集成进 CellScript，理由是 keeper 协调和交易提交属于应用层，加入 CSR 专用支持会带来不必要的耦合和维护开销 [S05]。 TalkDID 提案：PANAGOT 提出开源 Discourse 插件和主题，把 did:ckb 绑定到 Talk，解决版主和读者无法直接验证链上身份的问题 [S06]。面对“解决什么真实问题”的追问，提案者解释当前 Talk 账号只是普通 Discourse...

item.title: Spark Program | TalkDID — Bind did:ckb to Nervos Talk (3 posts)
item.description: Problem: Nervos Talk accounts are ordinary Discourse logins. did:ckb exists elsewhere (Metaforo/DAO, Vellum, bbs.fans), but there is no Discourse × did:ckb plugin — mods cannot see on-chain identity on Talk without screenshots. Solution: Open-source Discourse plugin + Theme Component (MIT after funding). User connects CCC → signs a short nonce → plugin verifies → stores bind on UserCustomField → badge on profile/posts. Non-goals: production Talk install (admin gate); DAO votes; Fiber tips; another DID tutorial. Why Spark / CKB: Committee already redirected a prior DID ask toward Discourse + CKB DID. item.title: Private payments in Cellula Wallet, on testnet (1 posts)
item.description: Private payments on CKB1600×900 50.8 KB We have been building private payments into Cellula Wallet, and they now run on CKB testnet. This post covers what they hide, what they do not, what they cost and how we checked them. It describes what a user and the chain see, not the internals. What stays private On CKB every payment is public. Inputs name the cells they spend, locks show who held them, and capacity is the amount. A private payment in Cellula takes three things off that record: Who paid. Nothing in the payment points to the payer’s cells or signature. It hides among the other payments in its group. Who was paid. Each payment goes to a new one-time key, and only the receiver’s view...

item.title: Twine: Buy and Sell CKB Without Depositing on an Exchange (Fiber P2P PoC) (2 posts)
item.description: Ask for Fiber eyes: coordinator fee on hold→payout without weakening escrow Quick status: the live sell path is already the buyer-minted preimage design. Buyer creates a payout invoice under H(S_b) on their node (Twine never sees S_b). Hub new_invoice with payment_hash = H(S_b) and no payment_preimage → hold. Seller pays that hold → status Received; inbound TLC stays held until RPC settle. Hub send_payment on the buyer invoice (same hash) → learns preimage → settle_invoice / SettleReceivedHoldTlcSet. Fiat never touches Twine. Cancel is refused once the hold is Received/Paid. Today payout_invoice_ok forces buyer invoice amount == trade.shannons (hold amount). Fees are still 0%. I want a...

item.description: Based on the Metaforo tally at close, the outcome is Passed.
